description: Roblox game development patterns, best practices, and common issues

patterns.description: Obby game with checkpoint system and coin-based shop
implementation_notes: All checkpoint saving must be server-authoritative
Coin collection must validate on server before awarding
Shop purchases must verify coin balance server-side
Use UpdateAsync for DataStore operations to prevent race conditions
Implement retry logic for transient DataStore failures
Cache player data in memory, persist periodically and on leave
security_requirements: Validate all RemoteEvent payloads for type and range
Rate-limit shop purchase requests to prevent spam
Verify player owns item before granting benefits
Log suspicious activity (impossible coin amounts, invalid purchases)
testing_checklist: Coins award correct amount on collection
Multiple players don't interfere with each other

best_practices: Use ReplicatedStorage for shared client/server modules
Use ServerScriptService for server-only code
Use StarterPlayerScripts for client-only code
Return frozen tables from modules to prevent mutation
Avoid circular dependencies between modules
Cache service references at module level
Use type annotations for better IDE support and type checking
anti_patterns: Avoid require() in loops or frequent code paths
Don't mutate module tables after return
Avoid tight coupling between unrelated modules

patterns.description: DataStore usage patterns for reliability and performance
best_practices: Use UpdateAsync for atomic operations
Implement retry logic with exponential backoff
Cache data in memory, persist periodically
Use pcall for all DataStore operations
Handle errors gracefully (don't crash on DataStore failure)
Respect rate limits (60 + numPlayers * 10 requests per minute)
Use ordered data stores for leaderboards
Version your data structure for migration support

security_rules: ALWAYS validate client input on server
NEVER trust client-supplied amounts, positions, or identifiers
Use type checking for all parameters
Implement rate limiting to prevent spam
Use RemoteFunctions only when you need server-to-client response
Never use RemoteFunctions for critical operations (can be exploited)
patterns.validation_template:
RemoteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, amount, itemId)
    -- Type validation
    if type(amount) ~= "number" or type(itemId) ~= "string" then
        warn("Invalid parameters from", player.Name)
        return
    end
    
    -- Range validation
    if amount < 0 or amount > MAX_COINS then
        warn("Suspicious coin amount from", player.Name)
        return
    end
    
    -- Business logic validation
    if not isValidItem(itemId) then
        warn("Invalid item ID from", player.Name)
        return
    end
    
    -- Process request
    processRequest(player, amount, itemId)
end)

common_exploits.mitigation: Server calculates all rewards, never trusts client values
Server validates checkpoint positions against known checkpoints

common_exploits.exploit: Client sends negative amounts to gain items
common_exploits.mitigation: Validate amount > 0 and amount <= player balance

patterns.description: Studio-safe defaults to prevent empty-map falls, bad requires, and DataStore noise during development
lessons_learned: Map scaffolds must be ModuleScripts to be require()'d from server scripts; .server.lua causes require failures.
Provide a fallback map (baseplate, spawn, checkpoints, tagged coins) so playtests don’t spawn into the void.
Mock DataStore in Studio to avoid publish-only errors; switch to real DataStore in live environments only.
UI should guard against missing config values (e.g., MAX_CHECKPOINT_STAGE) and nil UI descendants before string concatenation.
remediations: Keep MapBuilder as ModuleScript under ServerScriptService and require it from GameInitializer.
On server start, build a minimal map only when checkpoints/coins are absent; skip when user-provided assets exist.
Use RunService:IsStudio() to route to in-memory persistence; use DataStoreService only when not in Studio.
Default checkpoint max stage to a sane number and nil-check progress/coin labels before updating text.

patterns.description: Foundational building blocks for teaching Roblox Luau development

variable_binding.explanation: Always begin with local part = script.Parent to teach variable binding
variable_binding.example:
local part = script.Parent
part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")

instance_creation.explanation: Show Instance.new() + .Parent flow before adding logic
instance_creation.example:
local newPart = Instance.new("Part")
newPart.Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10)
newPart.Parent = workspace

conditionals.example:
if part.Anchored == true then
    print("Part is anchored")
elseif part.Transparency > 0.5 then
    print("Part is transparent")
else
    print("Part is normal")
end

functions.example:
local function add10(num)
    return num + 10
end

local result = add10(5)
print(result) -- 15

kill_brick.code:
local killBrick = script.Parent

killBrick.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
    local humanoid = hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.Health = 0
    end
end)
key_concepts: Always check for Humanoid before accessing it

player_detection.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
    local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
    if player then
        print(player.Name, "touched the part")
    end
end)
key_concepts: Use GetPlayerFromCharacter for reliable player detection
Always validate player exists before using

checkpoint_system.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local checkpoint = script.Parent
local checkpointNumber = tonumber(checkpoint.Name)

checkpoint.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
    local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
    if player and checkpointNumber then
        local stageValue = player.leaderstats.Stage
        if checkpointNumber > stageValue.Value then
            stageValue.Value = checkpointNumber
        end
    end
end)
key_concepts: Use tonumber() to convert string names to numbers
Only update if new checkpoint is higher

leaderstats_setup.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
    leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
    leaderstats.Parent = player
    
    local stage = Instance.new("IntValue")
    stage.Name = "Stage"
    stage.Value = 0
    stage.Parent = leaderstats
end)
key_concepts: leaderstats folder must be exact name

checkpoint_respawn.description: Teleport player to checkpoint on spawn
checkpoint_respawn.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local checkpointsFolder = workspace.Checkpoints

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local stage = player.leaderstats.Stage
        
        local checkpoint = checkpointsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(stage.Value))
        if checkpoint then
            hrp.CFrame = checkpoint.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        end
    end)
end)
key_concepts: Add offset to CFrame to avoid clipping

numeric_loop.example:
for i = 1, 10 do
    print("Iteration", i)
    task.wait(1)
end
numeric_loop.warning: Always include task.wait() in loops to prevent timeout

pairs_iteration.example:
for _, child in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
    if child:IsA("BasePart") then
        child.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
    end
end

infinite_loop.example:
while true do
    print("Running...")
    task.wait(1)  -- REQUIRED!
end
infinite_loop.warning: NEVER omit task.wait() in infinite loops - will crash server

debris.code:
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
Debris:AddItem(part, 5)  -- Destroys after 5 seconds

counter_limit.code:
local maxParts = 100
local currentParts = 0

function spawnPart()
    if currentParts >= maxParts then return end
    currentParts += 1
    -- spawn logic
end

reusability.explanation: Move repeated scripts to ServerScriptService and iterate
reusability.example:
local folder = workspace.KillParts

for _, killBrick in pairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
    if killBrick:IsA("BasePart") then
        killBrick.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
            local humanoid = hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if humanoid then
                humanoid.Health = 0
            end
        end)
    end
end
benefits: Single script handles all similar objects

best_practices: Always validate event inputs before using them
Never run infinite loops without task.wait()
Prefer server scripts in ServerScriptService over per-part scripts
Use Debris and counters to avoid runaway part spawns
Reference Roblox Dev Hub for unfamiliar APIs
Test with multiple players to catch race conditions
Use print() statements for debugging

common_mistakes.fix: Always add task.wait() in while loops
Use FindFirstChild and validate before accessing

common_mistakes.consequence: Service might not be loaded yet

common_mistakes.mistake: Creating separate scripts for identical objects
common_mistakes.consequence: Hard to maintain, lots of duplication
common_mistakes.fix: Use one script that iterates over folder of objects

common_issues.description: RemoteEvents vulnerable to exploits if client input not validated
symptoms: Players gaining impossible amounts of coins
Players purchasing items without sufficient funds
common_issues.solution: Always validate client inputs on server. Check types, ranges, and business logic before processing.
common_issues.code_fix:
-- BAD: Trusts client
RemoteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, coins)
    player.leaderstats.Coins.Value = coins
end)

-- GOOD: Validates input
RemoteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, coins)
    if type(coins) ~= "number" or coins < 0 or coins > 1000000 then
        return -- Invalid
    end
    if coins <= getPlayerCoins(player) then
        player.leaderstats.Coins.Value = coins
    end
end)
prevention: Server calculates all rewards and state changes
Client only sends intent ("collect coin"), not result ("add 10 coins")

common_issues.description: DataStore failures crash game or lose player data
symptoms: Script errors when DataStore is unavailable
common_issues.solution: Wrap all DataStore calls in pcall, implement retry logic, cache data in memory
common_issues.code_fix:
-- BAD: No error handling
local data = PlayerDataStore:GetAsync(userId)

-- GOOD: Handles errors
local function loadData(userId)
    for attempt = 1, 3 do
        local success, data = pcall(function()
            return PlayerDataStore:GetAsync(userId)
        end)
        
        if success then
            return data or {coins = 0, checkpoints = {}}
        else
            warn("DataStore error (attempt", attempt, "):", data)
            wait(2 ^ attempt) -- Exponential backoff
        end
    end
    
    warn("Failed to load data for", userId, "- using defaults")
    return {coins = 0, checkpoints = {}} -- Default data
end
prevention: Always use pcall for DataStore operations
Implement retry logic with exponential backoff
Provide default data when loading fails
Cache data in memory to reduce requests
Save data periodically, not just on player leave

common_issues.description: Poor performance from inefficient loops or :GetChildren() calls
common_issues.solution: Cache :GetChildren() results, avoid loops in Heartbeat, use WaitForChild sparingly
common_issues.code_fix:
-- BAD: Calls GetChildren in loop
while true do
    for _, player in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            -- Expensive operation
        end
    end
    wait()
end

-- GOOD: Caches results, uses events
local workspaceParts = workspace:GetChildren()
workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    table.insert(workspaceParts, child)
end)

for _, player in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
    for _, part in pairs(workspaceParts) do
        -- Much faster
    end
end
prevention: Avoid tight loops in Heartbeat or RenderStepped

common_issues.description: Memory leaks from unconnected events or retained references
common_issues.solution: Disconnect events when done, use Maid or Janitor pattern, avoid global references
common_issues.code_fix:
-- BAD: Never disconnects
local connection = part.Touched:Connect(function()
    -- Handle touch
end)

-- GOOD: Disconnects when done
local connection
connection = part.Touched:Connect(function()
    -- Handle touch
    connection:Disconnect()
end)

-- BETTER: Use cleanup pattern
local connections = {}
table.insert(connections, part.Touched:Connect(function() end))

-- On cleanup
for _, conn in pairs(connections) do
    conn:Disconnect()
end
prevention: Disconnect events when objects are destroyed
Avoid storing references in _G or global tables
